lastCompletedStory.title: Decouple sidecar narration push from the 30s idle-wait deadline

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-361) added and exported NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000 from src/tmux/dispatch.ts, strictly less than the unchanged IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS = 30_000. makeNotifyOrchestrator (src/supervisor/host.ts) now passes idleTimeoutMs: NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS in its sendKeysVerified options object; nothing else about that call changed (no sleepFn param added to makeNotifyOrchestrator's own signature -- the AC deliberately kept that DI surface at just capturePaneFn/logEvent). The 4 other sendKeysVerified call sites (issue.ts, review.ts, spec.ts, orch-recycle-watch.ts) are untouched and keep the full 30s deadline via their pre-existing options.idleTimeoutMs passthrough (defaults to undefined -> falls back to IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS in production). Regression test for the narration bound (test/supervisor/narration-idle-timeout.test.ts) drives the REAL idle-gate poll loop with an always-busy capturePaneFn and asserts wall-clock elapsed time, since makeNotifyOrchestrator has no sleepFn injection seam to fake time with -- see the new patterns.md bullet for why. file-size-budget.json's src/supervisor/host.ts ceiling was raised 1128->1136 for the doc-comment + one new options field; _ref updated accordingly.
